scripts.db:seed: docker-compose exec backend npx ts-node scripts/clear-and-seed.ts
scripts.db:seed:all: docker-compose exec backend npx ts-node scripts/clear-and-seed.ts --all
scripts.db:update-category-images: docker-compose exec backend npx ts-node scripts/update-main-category-images.ts
scripts.db:update-trust-user-1-avatar: docker-compose exec backend npx ts-node scripts/update-trust-user-1-avatar.ts
scripts.db:update-marketplace-banners: docker-compose exec backend npx ts-node scripts/update-marketplace-banners.ts
scripts.db:reset: docker-compose exec backend npx ts-node prisma/seed/clear-user-content-data.ts
scripts.db:reset:all: docker-compose exec backend npx ts-node prisma/seed/clear-seed-data.ts --force
scripts.db:reset:force: docker-compose exec backend npx prisma migrate reset --force --skip-seed
scripts.db:migrate: docker-compose exec backend npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: docker-compose exec backend npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:generate: docker-compose exec backend npx prisma generate
scripts.db:push: docker-compose exec backend npx prisma db push
scripts.db:status: docker-compose exec backend npx prisma migrate status
scripts.docker:clean: docker-compose down && docker-compose build --no-cache && docker-compose up -d
scripts.docker:clean:backend: docker-compose stop backend && docker-compose build --no-cache backend && docker-compose up -d backend
scripts.docker:clean:all: docker-compose down -v && docker-compose build --no-cache && docker-compose up -d
scripts.test:socket-chat: docker-compose exec backend npx ts-node scripts/test-socket-chat.ts
scripts.sim:julia: docker-compose exec backend npx ts-node scripts/julia-omer-simulation.ts julia
scripts.sim:omer: docker-compose exec backend npx ts-node scripts/julia-omer-simulation.ts omer
